reviews.text: We had such a lovely experience at Tails and Tubs. They treated Capri with such care, and the grooming came out absolutely perfect. Capri looked clean, fluffy, and super happy afterward. The staff were kind, patient, and clearly love what they do. We really appreciate the gentle handling and attention to detail. We’ll definitely be back! 🤍

The ladies who run this place are fantastic. We found them when they made space for us last minute for my two dogs Jacob and Pepper. We now take them back every six weeks and the pups always come back smelling fresh and look their best. I highly recommend them!

You will never find a better grooming team. Shout out to you all.

Couldn’t recommend the girls in Tails in Tubs enough, they are absolutely brilliant at what they do 🐶Willow has been going every 4-6 weeks since she was 12 weeks old and she loves her spa days. She gets so excited when we pull up outside and runs in the door without looking twice at me – I think that speaks for itself!! 🤣

Couldn’t recommend Tails in Tubs enough. The girls are always so professional, caring and brilliant with my dog. You can tell they genuinely love what they do, and I’m always delighted with the results!

Kenzo is a huge fan!!
The best quality service very very good at there job
Excellent service! The staff are so friendly and Luna absolutely loves going here. 🐾🐕 …
A huge thank you from Samos he had a great time and looks gorgeous 🫧💗 …
I would highly recommend Jordan who took care of Molly who has a strong dislike of groomers.   She  did such a wonderful job  and helped Molly feel at ease.  Molly looks amazing.  Thank you so much.

I couldn't recommend Jordan, Selena and Emily enough. My dog absolutely adores being dropped off for a groom. She even frequently falls asleep in their studio which speaks volumes about the comfortable and friendly environment that the girls create for the dogs. It's very comforting to know she's in excellent hands, and always comes out looking 5 stars. I wouldn't go anywhere else! Thank you girls!

Took my Shih Tzu Ella to Tails in Tubs in Cork today and honestly… I think she’s had a better spa day than I have in the last five years.

From the moment we walked in, Jordan had the place running like a five star dog hotel. Ella went in looking like a slightly disgruntled mop and came out looking like she has a shampoo endorsement deal with L’Oréal. I’m fairly sure she’s now expecting this level of treatment every week.

Cant impress enough how great this place is. It's brilliant leaving off your pup into their care and not having to worry for a moment about their welfare. Our senior dog Tank doesn't even look back going through the door, he absolutely loves them!

Always such a great experience with the girls at Tail in Tubs! They are amazing to deal with, and both my dogs love going to them!

The team here are absolutely fantastic.
I can't say enough good things about Tails in Tubs. They are true professionals. From the moment you walk in, you can tell they are passionate about what they do. Would highly recommend bringing your dogs here as they treat them like their own.
Jordan was wonderful with my nervous rescue dog. Thank you!
We sent our dog Millie for a groom in Tails and Tubs they managed to fit her in last minute and we were very greatful. They were both so kind and they did a great job. We will definitley return.
